mismatches.title: Almost threw it in the trash! Needs better labeling on outside envelope.
mismatches.text: I love Amazon and shop continuously on it.  I bought a gift card for my mom for Xmas and the tracking info actually said I would get it one day earlier than the other products I ordered at the same time.  So when a non descript sealed envelope came in a box with something else I tossed it on the counter thinking it was junk mail like so many other companies send with their products.  I actually forgot about the GC as I expected it to come snail mail solo.  So this envelope sat for a few days and as I was tossing it into the recycle bin I decided to tear it open.  What to my surprise was inside but another envelope, the holiday card and gift card.  Wow was I surprised.  Since the outside envelope is just packaging it should be better labeled as to the contents.

mismatches.title: Beware of packaging
mismatches.text: I purchased a $50 gift card and had it sent to a relative. All of the online documentation indicated the recipient would not know what was in the package.  There was a box during the order process for a To: and From: and I also added "Do Not Open Until Christmas". The package arrived on the specified day but the label on the outside of the box did not have any indication of my note.  The recipient opened the box to find a sealed Amazon envelope and a packing slip.  The sealed envelope contained the gift card.  I figured the note should be here; nope.  I finally found the note on the packing slip.  OK, that's fine, but the packing slip also had the description of what was inside the sealed envelope including the denomination of the gift card; so much for a surprise.

mismatches.title: Leave yourself time to match gifts to recipients!
mismatches.text: Gift card tin arrived with Santa bag on time. However, the recipient information was tossed in the package without any reference to the actual gifts. Luckily I knew which tag went with which gift, and the gift values weee the same. However, this was a problem for gifts sent directly to recipients. The only gifts which were properly marked were the gift-wrapped items, but even those arrived with extra recipient tags adding to confusion. We should not have to build-a-gift at these prices. Amazon, you can do much better than this!
